description: Start a job to create a new Grid session.

initialQuery.description: When provided, the grid will be initialized using the provided query against a table or view. The grid columns will match the query select statement. One row will be added to the grid for each row returned by the query. Optional, if present the recordSetId cannot be included.

recordSetId.description: When provided, the grid will be initialized using the CSV file stored for the given record set id. The grid columns will match the header of the CSV. Optional, if present the initialQuery cannot be included.
